### What does this PR do?

Add production-oriented vLLM prefill-decode disaggregation support for Ascend RL rollouts.

The change:

- enables Ascend PD through vLLM-Ascend MooncakeConnectorV1;
- supports asymmetric prefill/decode TP and role-specific memory, batching, and sequence limits;
- adds decode routing policies, including round-robin, random, power-of-two, consistent hash, rendezvous hash, and cache-aware routing;
- exposes separate prefill/decode metrics endpoints and labels;
- preserves request affinity across turns and safely drains in-flight PD requests before sleep or KV cache release;
- synchronizes weight updates and cache invalidation across all prefill/decode servers.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+prefill+decode+disaggregation
- [x] PR title follows the required module and type format.

### Test

CPU unit tests cover PD configuration, replica construction, Ascend connector settings, role-specific overrides, routing policies, request draining, and metrics endpoints.

Validation and performance results will be added in a follow-up comment.

### API and Usage Example

```bash
++actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.enabled=True \
++actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.prefill_replicas=1 \
++actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.decode_replicas=3 \
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.decode_tensor_model_parallel_size=4 \
++actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.transfer_backend=mooncake \
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.disaggregation.decode_policy.type=power_of_two
```

### Design & Code Changes

A vLLMPDReplica owns one prefill engine and multiple decode engines. Requests enter through the prefill endpoint, transfer KV state through the configured connector, and are routed to a decode engine by the selected policy. All P/D engines remain part of the same rollout replica for weight synchronization, cache lifecycle, sleep/wake, and metrics collection.

- [ ] Apply all repository pre-commit checks.
- [ ] Add or update documentation.
- [x] Add unit tests covering the new rollout behavior.
- [ ] Request CI after the PR is ready for review.

+        prompt_ids: Sequence[int] | None = None,

+            self._round_robin_cursor += 1
+            return selected
+        if policy == "power_of_two":
+            return self._select_power_of_two(candidates)
+        if policy in ("consistent_hash", "rendezvous_hash"):
+            if routing_key is None:
+                raise ValueError(f"{policy} requires routing_key")
+            if policy == "consistent_hash":
+                return self._select_consistent_hash(candidates, routing_key)
+            return max(candidates, key=lambda index: _fbi_hash(f"{routing_key}:{self.peer_ids[index]}"))
+        if prompt_ids is None:
+            raise ValueError("cache_aware requires prompt_ids")
+        return self._select_cache_aware(candidates, prompt_ids)
+
+    def _validate_candidates(self, candidates: Sequence[int]) -> None:
+        if not candidates:
+            raise RuntimeError("no eligible decode peer")
+        if len(set(candidates)) != len(candidates):
+            raise ValueError("eligible decode peer indices must be unique")
+        if any(index < 0 or index >= len(self.pending_requests) for index in candidates):
+            raise ValueError(f"eligible decode peer index out of range: {candidates}")
+
+    def _select_power_of_two(self, candidates: Sequence[int]) -> int:
+        if len(candidates) == 1:
+            return candidates[0]
+        first, second = self._sampler.sample(candidates, 2)
+        return first if self.pending_requests[first] <= self.pending_requests[second] else second

+    def _select_consistent_hash(self, candidates: Sequence[int], routing_key: str) -> int:
+        if not self._hash_ring:
+            raise RuntimeError("consistent-hash ring is not initialized")
+        position = bisect.bisect_left(self._hash_points, _fbi_hash(routing_key))
+        if position == len(self._hash_ring):
+            position = 0
+        selected = self._hash_ring[position][1]

+    def _select_cache_aware(self, candidates: Sequence[int], prompt_ids: Sequence[int]) -> int:
+        if self._cache_tree is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("cache-aware radix tree is not initialized")

+            else:

+        self._cache_tree.insert(prompt_ids, selected)
+        return selected
+
+    def _evict_cache_if_due(self) -> None:
+        if self._cache_tree is None:
+            return
+        interval = self.config.eviction_interval_secs
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        if interval <= 0 or now - self._last_eviction < interval:
+            return
+        for tenant in range(len(self.pending_requests)):
+            self._cache_tree.evict_tenant_by_size(tenant, self.config.max_tree_size)
+        self._last_eviction = now

+        if self.pending_requests[index] < 1:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"decode peer {index} has no in-flight request to release")
+        self.pending_requests[index] -= 1
+

+        if self._cache_tree is not None:
+            self._cache_tree = _TokenRadixTree(len(self.pending_requests))
+            self._last_eviction = time.monotonic()
